name: Pain Free You (Dan Buglio)
founders: Dan Buglio (lay mind-body coach and musician, Bucks County PA; recovered from 11-13 years of back pain and sciatica, depending on the source; says he 'studied psychology' but lists no degree or clinical license)
founded_year_range: 2019. The YouTube channel joined 3 Mar 2019 (verified), and the ATNS bio counts 2,500+ daily videos since March 2019. The paid membership started around 2020-21 (inferred from the Join page's 'over 2 years of daily videos'). The book came out Jan 2025 (audiobook copyright 2024).
cost_summary: Free video library and self-assessment. Group Coaching & Video Course membership is US$100/month, cancel anytime, with no guarantee or refund stated (verified Oct 2026). The book (paperback, Kindle, Audible; Jan 2025) sells at retail prices. 1-on-1 coaching is listed but stated to be unavailable. The typical-cost figure assumes about 6 months of membership.
conditions_claimed: hEDS, arthritis/RA, some autoimmune disease, EBV reactivation, asthma, SIBO, skin and urological symptoms
mechanisms: neuroplastic/learned pain (brain-generated danger signal / predictive processing)
autonomic/nervous system dysregulation (sympathetic overdrive, "stuck in fight-or-flight")
mechanism_summary: Symptoms are framed as protective warning signals from an over-protective brain that perceives danger ('perceived danger' = TMS/PDP), not as tissue damage. Fear, symptom monitoring, catastrophizing, stress, unresolved emotions and personality traits (perfectionism, people-pleasing) keep the system in fight-or-flight and reinforce the learned pathway through neuroplasticity. Repeatedly convincing the brain that the body is safe ends the symptoms. The same mechanism is applied to about 100 listed conditions, on the argument that 'the brain controls the entire body.'
techniques: acceptance of a mind-body diagnosis via self-assessment and mind-body-vs-structural tests
graded resumption of feared activities (six steps; Do More-Do Less)
reducing catastrophizing, symptom checking and 'watching the calendar'
reframing negative emotions worksheet; addressing stress, perfectionism and people-pleasing
calming the nervous system (fight-or-flight to rest-and-recovery)
live group coaching Q&A ~12 h/week, plus peer Facebook group and success-story videos
mainstream_notes: Not used in health systems or guidelines. Recognized within the neuroplastic-symptom (TMS/PPD) community: Buglio has a session at the 2026 ATNS conference (Session 8A, 'Simplifying Mind-Body Symptom Recovery', verified) and is a frequent podcast guest.
insurance_notes: Direct-pay subscription for lay coaching by a coach who is not a licensed clinician. Not reimbursable.
controversy: A lay coach with no clinical credentials who classifies symptoms as mind-body from a permissive checklist. The site states that answering 'yes' to even one clue 'means your brain is creating pain or symptoms based on perceived danger', and that pain can be ended regardless of imaging. The condition list is extremely broad: RA, autoimmune disease, hEDS, MCAS, asthma, SIBO, ME/CFS PEM, long COVID. That breadth risks missed diagnoses and is contested by ME/CFS advocates, although the site advises a medical check first. Results rest only on testimonials, and the subscription is open-ended. No public scandals were found, but an independent search for criticism was limited by the search budget.

indicators.value: 'thousands of members' (self-reported); book copy claims 2,000+ coached

popularity.reach_estimate: ~100k-300k people reached cumulatively, mostly through free videos (12.3M views, 72.5K subscribers, 22.6K FB followers). Paid members probably number in the low thousands (self-reported 2,000+).
popularity.method_notes: Founding date comes from the YouTube join date and the ATNS bio. Growth anchors: ~1,200 videos by ~2022, 2,500+ by 2026, the Jan 2025 book and audiobook plus podcast tour, and ATNS speaker status in 2026. YouTube counts were re-verified 2026-10-12. The trajectory assumes steady audience growth with a step up at the book launch. Reddit and Google Trends were not checked because the web-search budget was exhausted. Reach was estimated from cumulative views divided by a rough views-per-person figure, plus follower counts.
